extensions.name: Nimora Compact
extensions.description: A lightweight Nimora bundle with the core movie, TV, anime, sports and LayarKaca providers.
extensions.author: nimbusfvck
releaseNotes: Added a minimum TMDB rating of 6 to the Korean Series row so low-rated or unrated titles are excluded.
Improved Indonesian Movies and Korean movie/series rows by removing the 180-day cutoff, and increased TMDB poster artwork to w780 for sharper mobile heroes.
Fixed Football Highlights pagination so the All-category shelf collects enough playable posts for See more.
Added TMDB list metadata for overview, original titles and languages, genres, countries, and rating vote counts.
Fixed Febbox quality switching so 1080p remains available after selecting 720p or 360p, and deduplicated cached source labels during refresh.
Restored Febbox 360p and 720p variants when quality playlists are individually returned as HLS masters, and simplified the source label to the provider name.
Added TimStreams live-event sources and reused its event artwork in the existing sports catalog while preserving FotMob as football metadata authority.
Restored Football Highlights on Home and the All category by wiring the Time Soccer catalog bridge.
Restored Febbox fixed-quality variants so 720p and 360p remain available alongside the adaptive HLS source.
Grouped Febbox quality links into one Auto source with fixed resolutions as playback variants, while keeping master HLS adaptive.
Split Febbox quality playlists into independently selectable sources while refreshing signed URLs on resolve.
Kept Febbox master HLS playlists intact for native adaptive quality; fixed-quality playlists remain selectable variants.
Kept All-category search on TMDB and made Anime search AniList-first with Sokuja fallback when AniList errors.
Changed Febbox quality links into variants on one source, preserving 2160p/1080p/720p choices while keeping startup quality selection lightweight.
Removed TMDB from the AniList anime detail path; episode titles, thumbnails, trailers, and related anime collections now come directly from AniList.
Fixed Febbox source discovery by using the file fid and prioritizing signed quality-list HLS URLs before legacy playback fallbacks.
Fixed Febbox quality resolution by sending the share key and accepting the top-level quality HTML returned by Febbox.
Fixed AniSkip markers for AniList episodes mapped through TMDB seasons by querying the absolute anime episode number.
Fixed Febbox playback by resolving the signed HLS URL through the player endpoint, forwarding the personal ui cookie only to Febbox, and rejecting invalid HLS responses.
Made long-running anime details load TMDB seasons lazily, while preserving absolute episode mapping for playback and subtitles across multi-season anime such as One Piece.
Added the Febbox provider with direct ShowBox-to-Febbox HLS resolution, optional personal ui cookie forwarding only to Febbox, fresh signed URLs, and 4K rendition discovery.
Added KickassAnime as an HLS anime source with fresh iOS-compatible playback resolution, subtitle tracks, and season-safe matching.

Made AniList anime details TMDB-first for richer metadata, episode titles, and per-episode artwork; preserved AniList episode refs and absolute multi-season mapping so long-running anime such as One Piece continue matching Sokuja and Indomax.

Routed TMDB requests through the private Cloudflare proxy with edge caching and server-side key rotation, so AniList episode details can load TMDB still artwork without exposing API keys in the bundle; AniList cover/banner artwork remains the fallback.
Centralized TMDB API requests with key rotation across available keys so anime artwork and metadata survive stale or rate-limited keys.
Moved All-category anime rankings to AniList with Sokuja fallback and added lazy TMDB episode still artwork for AniList anime details.
Added persistent AniList caching, duplicate-request coalescing, and a conservative 75-request-per-minute guard to stay below AniList's 90-request limit.
Switched the Anime category to AniList-first data with Sokuja fallback and added a minimum TMDB vote count of 10 for Korean Series.
Sorted Korean Movies and Korean Series by TMDB rating, using popularity as the tie-breaker.
Switched the Indonesian Movies category row to Indomax's rated country catalog with direct detail metadata and playback refs, while retaining TMDB fallback.
Prioritized rated Indonesian and Korean movie rows plus Korean Series by TMDB daily Trending Today rankings, with rated non-trending titles kept as fallback.
Disabled the Idlix stream provider while its upstream API is blocked by a Cloudflare challenge; added HD TMDB alternate backdrops and restored TMDB title logos for the Featured Summary.
Fixed See more pagination for Indonesian and Korean movie/series rows and limited country movie rows to TMDB digital releases without vote-count filtering.
Added recent Indonesian and Korean movie rows plus recent Korean series, without vote-count filtering; removed Indonesian Series from the category layout.
Added Trending Today rows to the Movie, TV Shows, and Anime categories; Movie and TV use TMDB daily trends, while Anime uses Sokuja's weekly ranking.
Changed the Sokuja Anime category to show Most Popular, Most Rating, Most Recent, and genre shelves together as separate rows.
Removed the Movie/TV grid catalog and improved Movie, TV, and Sokuja Anime sections with popularity, rating, recent, and genre browsing.
Updated Movie and TV category sections to Most Popular, Most Rating, Most Recent, and TMDB genre rows.
Fixed Savefilm Abyss player 3 playback by rebuilding fresh `/sora` MP4 URLs and preserving 360p, 720p, and 1080p variants.
Changed Hydrax Auto startup to the highest validated rendition up to 720p while keeping higher qualities available for manual selection.
Added Idlix movie and TV episode streams using Nimora's existing titles, with fresh gate/session resolution and subtitles.
Added CDNLiveTV event discovery and fresh HLS channel resolution.
Removed Featured Sports from the all category; it remains available only to Home's Featured Hero.
Fixed the Featured Sports catalog registration so Home's Featured Hero loads it without rendering an erroneous Home shelf.
Added a Featured Sports catalog so highly rated upcoming football big matches can enter Home's Featured Hero before kickoff without being marked live.
Renamed the Nimora matches catalog label from Live Now to Sports Matches to distinguish it from the Home live shelf.
Removed Jikan completely, including its anime provider, anime shelves, alias lookups, and health probes.
Switched Motorsport catalog data back to RoxieStreams so live and recently finished events remain available in the timeline; SPOTV is no longer used for catalog data.
Removed the Live Now shelf from the All category; live events remain available through the Live timeline.
Removed Jikan completely, including its anime provider, anime shelves, alias lookups, and health probes.
Made SPOTV the authoritative Motorsport catalog source with current timestamps and artwork; Cricfy, PlayZTV, and RoxieStreams remain stream resolvers with kickoff-based matching.
Removed stale or duplicate generic Motorsport catalog rows so events such as MotoGP use SPOTV's schedule and live state.
Added Roxie Fighting and Motorsports page feeds so current UFC, boxing, MXGP, MotoGP, NASCAR, and related events appear in Nimora.
Removed the global Schedule category, kept Live as a timeline, and filtered stale Cricfy events after their sport-specific expiry window.
Removed FCTV33, kept finished FotMob matches in Schedule as ended, and prevented stale provider events from reappearing in Live Now.
Fixed duplicate football matches caused by abbreviated provider team names, renamed the Home live shelf to Live Now, and renamed the Sport category to Schedule.
Added RoxieStreams as a source-only sports provider: its countdown determines live/upcoming status, unmatched events can be added, and FotMob remains the Football SSOT.
Disabled FCTV33 Live Events because its provider CDN rejects the app playback path with HTTP 403.
Fixed FCTV playback by matching the web token flow: decoding obfuscated stream URLs, creating the rb-session AES-CBC token URL, validating playlist media, and retrying fallback edges.

Fixed FCTV live playback by validating playlist media segments before returning a source, retrying fresh signed stream details, filtering Sorotan items, and showing tournament names on live event cards.
Added FCTV33 live-event fallback streams and provider-only football events to Live, while keeping FotMob as the Football schedule source.
Added separate horizontal Movie and TV shelves to their category pages, including Top By Genre rows, while keeping mixed shelves on Home.
Fixed League Channels returning empty in the live catalog when the PlayZTV category feed is loaded through the published bundle.
Added League Channels to Live with Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Champions League, and Europa League shelves sourced from channel links in PlayZTV and Cricfy.
Hardened the Jikan anime catalog against upstream 504s with persistent cache, serialized requests, retries, and stale-data fallback while reducing the initial All-category request burst.
Added cached cross-source anime title aliases from MAL/Jikan and Anime Relations Mapping, so Sokuja and LayarKaca can search alternate anime names automatically for both series and episodes.
Fixed LK21 movie matching so a partial title such as Dreams cannot select a different movie such as Train Dreams, and renamed the TMDB popularity shelves to Popular Movies and Popular TV Series.
Fixed LK21 ratings so they appear on both catalog cards and detail pages.
Changed the All Time movie and series shelves to popularity rankings and moved Oscar Nominees and Cannes Film Festival to the bottom of Home.
Restored the Coming Soon Home shelf and fixed Movies on LK21 pagination so additional pages load correctly.
Removed the Coming Soon shelf from Home.
Fixed Cricfy football source matching when the provider abbreviates team names, including Atl. Madrid for Atlético Madrid.
Fixed Sokuja quality mapping so each episode exposes one source with its available 480p, 720p, and 1080p playback variants.
Fixed PlayZTV current-feed decoding and endpoint fallback, restored Cricfy in Compact, and hardened Sokuja artwork and episode-date parsing.
Moved the Anime catalog and Home anime shelves to Sokuja, adding Sokuja's Top Anime All Time and Popular Anime This Week rankings while retaining AniList metadata for existing references.
Made Premier League Shorts follow FotMob's current season and matchweek, merging active and latest-played Clipro feeds so new matchweek moments keep appearing automatically.
Moved the LayarKaca catalog to the All category with separate Movies on LK21 and TV Series on LK21 sections; the TV section uses Series Unggulan.
Added PlayZTV as an independent live-event stream provider with fresh link and token resolution, so it can be enabled separately from other stream providers.
Changed the LayarKaca catalog to a compact Home shelf section so movie and TV catalogs remain visible together; the full catalog is still available through See more.

Added an independent LayarKaca catalog for films and series. LayarKaca catalog and stream providers can now be enabled separately, with catalog series retaining direct episode playback through LayarKaca streams.
Added Dramadev as a stream-only movie source for TMDB movies, with exact title matching and fresh HLS resolution while keeping Dracin catalog playback intact.
Curated UEFA Champions League and Premier League Shorts to the 20 newest playable items and added movie, TV and football tags for Shorts filtering.
Added paginated Dramaverse and Storyreel Shorts catalogs with per-item tags and episode playback through fresh HLS resolution.
Restored Hydrax quality variants from decoder responses and updated P2P Playcdn resolution for the current `/verify/{slug}` flow.
Made Hydrax start playback from the lowest validated quality by default while keeping the quality variants ordered from highest to lowest for manual selection.
Fixed LayarKaca TurboVIP resolution by retrying the parent watch page and capturing the nested EmTurbovid player before WebView timeout.
Exposed title logos for all TMDB Trending Movie and TV catalog items with bounded, memoized artwork lookups.
Curated Football to include Saudi Pro League and exclude UEFA Youth League.
Fixed football league icons by using FotMob's canonical league artwork and primary competition IDs, including Champions League.
Fixed Champions League fixtures disappearing when FotMob uses season-specific league IDs and primary competition IDs.
Fixed LayarKaca `/iframe3/` resolution by parsing the nested player after a browser/Cloudflare fetch, avoiding parent-page timeouts while preserving source and quality extraction.
Initial Nimora Compact bundle with the core catalog, playback, subtitle and LayarKaca providers.
